description: Apply the translation column of a file written by export_texts back into the project's data. DRY RUN BY DEFAULT: reports what would change and nothing is written until dryRun=false. Rows with an empty translation are skipped. A row whose `original` no longer matches the project text (the text changed after export) is skipped unless force=true. Dialogue translations longer than 4 lines are split into several message boxes automatically; choices are kept in sync. Control codes (\C[n], \V[n], \N[n] ...) are compared with the original and mismatches are reported as warnings.

file.description: Path relative to the project folder, e.g. localization/texts.csv

force.description: Apply rows even if their original text no longer matches

name: import_texts
title: Import translated texts
